feedback: The illustration accurately depicts the contemplative elderly teacher studying scriptures beside a glowing lamp at night.
The illustration accurately captures a thoughtful Nicodemus at an arched stone window overlooking nighttime Jerusalem, aligning well with the text's reflective mood.
The illustration accurately depicts Nicodemus walking cautiously through a moonlit stone alleyway at night, well matching the quiet tension of the text.
The illustration matches the warm stone room, oil lamp, and reverent encounter between Nicodemus and Jesus well, though Nicodemus is standing rather than seated.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus teaching with a calm gesture while Nicodemus listens in astonished perplexity under warm lamplight.
The illustration captures Nicodemus questioning Jesus with earnest confusion in a warm, lamp-lit stone setting.
The illustration accurately portrays Jesus gently teaching Nicodemus with a cup on the table under warm nighttime lighting.
The illustration accurately depicts Jesus pointing toward the open stone window at night while Nicodemus listens attentively.
The illustration effectively captures the emotional nighttime dialogue between Jesus and Nicodemus, reflecting the warmth and reverence of the biblical text.
The warm, lamplit nighttime setting and peaceful expressions accurately depict the transformative conversation between Nicodemus and Jesus described in the text.
